Maya Patel: Quick heads-up — Harborline QBR dry run moved to 4:00pm PT today. Can everyone join a 3:10pm PT soundcheck (20m) so we can run order + mic check? Slides: https://docs.google.com/harborline-qbr (please do not edit other folks' slides)

Sam Torres: 3:10 works. I'll shorten the onboarding backlog slide and move the full ticket table to the appendix link. Suggest we keep the main deck <= 20m.

Kevin Liu: I can own the cost/usage slide. Need last 30d metrics and a quick projection for a 3-month Dedicated pilot. @Sam can you drop numbers here?

Ryan Chen: In. Also want to confirm which customer execs will attend so we can tailor the asks/demos. Need a demo fallback plan.

Maya Patel: Customer execs expected: CTO Anika Rao and Head of Product Marco. Good call on fallback — let's include a 2min recorded demo + a 3-bullet script for when live fails.

Sam Torres: Pulling metrics now. SQL I ran:
```
SELECT date, sum(tokens) AS tokens_consumed, avg(latency_ms) AS avg_latency, percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency_ms) AS p95_latency
FROM telemetry.events
WHERE account = 'harborline' AND date >= CURRENT_DATE - 30
GROUP BY date
ORDER BY date;
```
Summary (last 30d): tokens=980k, avg latency=92ms, p95=210ms. Raw per-day table moved to appendix. :thumbsup: 

Kevin Liu: Got it. I'll produce a low/likely/high cost impact range for the Dedicated pilot and annotate assumptions (utilization, quantization profile, burst policy). Will flag model-compat caveats.

Maya Patel: Draft ask language for execs: "We recommend a 3-month Dedicated pilot to validate SLA-backed latency and predictable unit cost; may we present a short pilot proposal you can review?" Keep it non-prescriptive. Thoughts?

Ryan Chen: That reads well. I'll own the demo fallback: upload recording + 3-bullet script (when to switch, recovery steps, contact).

Sam Torres: Trimmed deck and updated appendix link. File version v7. I removed the full ticket table from main deck and left a link to the ticket board.

calendar-bot: Reminder scheduled for 2026-05-18T22:10:00Z — Harborline QBR dry run (soundcheck at 3:10pm PT).

Maya Patel: Run of show for 3:10 soundcheck (20m):
1) Maya — 2m intro
2) Kevin — 6m cost & usage + pilot projection
3) Sam — 7m onboarding/product health + risks
4) Ryan — 3m demo/fallback summary
5) Maya — 2m asks & next steps
Please be signed in 5m early.

Ryan Chen: Uploading 2:05 recording now and adding fallback bullets.

Kevin Liu: Posting updated slide at 2:50pm PT with numbers.

Sam Torres: Confirmed metrics pasted into Kevin's slide. Deck updated and comments enabled.

Maya Patel: After the run I'll capture action items in this thread. Target: final deck to execs by EOD tomorrow.

(30m later)

Maya Patel: Dry run complete. Quick notes: flow good, CTO wants more on SLOs and rollback plan, Product liked pilot framing but asked for a cost cap. Demo worked but had a 10s hiccup — fallback switch was smooth.

Action items captured here (owners & due dates):
- Kevin Liu: Finalize pilot cost range and add cost cap scenarios (due 2026-05-20).
- Sam Torres: Add appendix table with per-day tokens + link to ticket board (due 2026-05-19).
- Ryan Chen: Upload final recording and fallback script to slide appendix (due 2026-05-19).
- Maya Patel: Draft pilot proposal email and schedule exec follow-up (due 2026-05-18 EOD).
- All: Be ready for final deck review at 10:00am PT tomorrow.

Sam Torres: Noted all items. Will push appendix by EOD.

Kevin Liu: On it. I'll include the utilization assumption and quantization notes.

Maya Patel: Thanks team — we'll convert this thread into the exec follow-up doc and link the final deck when done. :rocket:
